scope: Local read-only review of excluded E allocation instrumentation and retained control/compiler evidence. No reviewer build, test execution or remote access.
review: The diagnostic is based directly on E. Splitting Local/Cached match arms retains the original answer actions; Stale retains its original send-before-refresh behavior.

The System GlobalAlloc wrapper counts successful alloc and realloc separately, standalone dealloc, and complete requested/released sizes. Default alloc_zeroed is included through alloc. Counter callbacks do not allocate.

Step begins at step_udp entry and drops after its owned locals, covering receive, admission, synchronous processing/send and owned drops. No-packet/error attempts remain separate from Cached, Local, OtherPacket and Stale.

Turn encloses the complete normal owner-loop body, including control/file work, service steps and the following poll. Its cached-only category is based on UDP query kinds and can include control work.

The only source finding was unguarded classification from deferred interface/MAC continuations. Commit 6d6e6038 records DEPTH==0 in unscoped_classifications and returns without changing KIND. This exposes invalid attribution; it does not reconstruct deferred per-query totals.
The report snapshots completed step/turn totals and writes once after the normal loop, before shutdown draining. Output allocations are outside both guards.

control_fixture.method: Independently recomputed the exact expected vectors from explicit alloc(16), realloc(32), alloc_zeroed(24), an 8-byte allocation outside Step but inside Turn, and a separate Local 8-byte allocation. Read and compared retained JSON without executing the fixture.
control_fixture.expected_histogram: Only alloc-count bucket 2 has value 1; every other bucket is zero.
control_fixture.deliberate_invalid_scope_probe: The final fixture calls classify(Cached) outside Step. Exactly one unscoped event is required, while every original query/total/turn/histogram value remains unchanged. This positive control is not a valid device measurement.

local_compile_evidence.coordinator_report: Final Linux-musl bin cargo check returned exit 0.
local_compile_evidence.direct_log_evidence: No error diagnostic; Finished dev profile [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 0.09s. Warnings remain.
local_compile_evidence.limit: The logs corroborate compiler completion; target/command/exit status are coordinator-reported. The review did not rerun compilation or execute the daemon.

device_count_validity_requirements: Verify the intended single-thread UDP workload. Global counters include allocations from any thread; nested_steps alone does not establish single-thread execution.
Require nested_steps == 0 and unscoped_classifications == 0. Any nonzero value invalidates complete per-query attribution.
Require the report to exist and parse, and verify final daemon exit code 0. A report can be written before a later shutdown error.
Validate the cached-query denominator against the intended workload; no-packet/error step counts are not queries.
Label cached-only turn allocations per cached query as a conditional subset. It excludes no-packet and mixed-turn totals and must not be described as the entire run's allocation cost.
limitations: Counts describe Rust GlobalAlloc requests, not every native allocator operation. Byte totals describe requested/released traffic, not live heap size, RSS or physical realloc copying.
The fixture's successful process exit alone is insufficient: absent output environment configuration can still exit 0. Exact JSON validation above is the counter evidence.
Initial setup before the normal loop and shutdown after it are outside Turn. Deferred/control work occurring inside the loop is included.
This is count-only diagnostic evidence. The instrumented ELF must not be timed, deployed or used as a performance-acceptance artifact.
